description: R08 Functional Closeout checkpoint: retire the complete UtilsTests and MathTests functional families plus the TerminalBuffer tab-stop subcluster after green Rust CI and Quality Census on the published product/witness HEAD.

entries.notes: Rust reproduces Microsoft's default 8-column tab stops, clear-all behavior, and RIS-style reset.
Rust preserves sorted tab-stop insertion at head/middle/tail and duplicate suppression.
Rust clears existing head/middle/tail stops and leaves state unchanged for nonexistent stops.
Rust advances to the next configured stop and clamps to the rightmost buffer column when none remains.
Rust moves to the previous configured stop and clamps to column zero when none precedes the cursor.
Rust matches Microsoft's full ceiling and narrowing matrix, including non-finite and out-of-range rejection.
Rust matches Microsoft's full flooring and narrowing matrix.
Rust matches Microsoft's full rounding and narrowing matrix, including negative half-away-from-zero behavior.
Rust preserves identity for normal signed integer inputs including both i32 extrema.
Rust clamps below the supplied minimum and above SHORT_MAX exactly as Microsoft tests require.
Rust reproduces Microsoft's XParseColor rgb:/# scaling, case handling, X11 names/variants, gray levels, and invalid-sequence rejection.
Rust preserves trailing whitespace for multiline paste payloads where Microsoft deliberately avoids trimming.
Rust preserves Microsoft's absolute, tilde, POSIX-rooted, and relative starting-directory decisions.
Rust reproduces CR/LF normalization and C0/C1 control filtering over Microsoft's ASCII and Unicode vectors.
Rust emits braced/plain GUID strings and round-trips the Microsoft GUID field layout.
Rust reproduces WSL executable qualification, --cd injection/suppression, System32 checks, tilde behavior, and //wsl path normalization with platform lookups injected.
Rust matches Microsoft's delimiter split behavior including leading, trailing, adjacent, and absent delimiters.
Rust accepts Microsoft's decimal unsigned vectors and rejects empty/non-decimal inputs.
Rust trims Microsoft's single-line trailing whitespace vectors without altering interior tabs.
